phase: Final delivery closeout slice 004: minimal frontend MaterialTask workspace panel (frontend-only).
summary: Added a compact, operational 任务 (MaterialTask) frontend panel that drives the existing same-origin backend task APIs end to end: create/list/load/save task, task evidence search/attach/approve, and generate/audit/export-preflight/export-docx. No backend routes changed, no dependencies added, no network beyond the browser calling the local backend. Task evidence approval is framed as a manual, deterministic lexical confirmation, never a semantic entailment / truth judgement.
implemented: index.html: nav button <button class="nav" data-panel="tasks">任务</button> and section#tasks.panel with all required stable ids: taskCreateBtn, taskRefreshBtn, taskList, taskCurrentId, taskLoadCurrentBtn, taskSaveCurrentBtn, taskEvidenceQuery, taskEvidenceSearchBtn, taskEvidenceResults, taskAttachManualBtn, taskApproveSelectedBtn, taskGenerateBtn, taskAuditBtn, taskPreflightBtn, taskExportDocxBtn, taskStatus, taskLog.
app.js createTask(): POST /api/tasks from current compose fields/genre/facts/draft plus local state.evidence (carried as selected_evidence).
app.js refreshTasks()/renderTaskList(): GET /api/tasks, newest first, each row has a 'set current' button; switching to the tasks panel auto-refreshes.
app.js loadCurrentTask(): GET /api/tasks/{id}, writes genre/title/fields/facts/draft and selected_evidence back into the compose workspace and state.evidence.
app.js saveCurrentTask(): PUT /api/tasks/{id} with current compose state.
app.js searchTaskEvidence(): POST /api/tasks/{id}/evidence/search (empty query -> backend uses task title/fields).
app.js attachSelectedEvidence(): single-select one search result, POST /api/tasks/{id}/evidence/attach with {item}.
app.js approveTaskEvidence(): collects attached evidence ids, POST /api/tasks/{id}/evidence/approve with {evidence_ids}; labelled manual/deterministic lexical confirmation.
app.js auditTask(): POST /api/tasks/{id}/audit, renders compact status/blocker/failure/repair-unit/can-export counts.
app.js preflightTask(): POST /api/tasks/{id}/export/preflight, renders can_export and paragraph/font/table summary.

Constraints met: separate GET helper apiGet (distinct from POST api); escapeHtml used in renderTaskList/renderTaskEvidenceResults/renderTaskStatus; every action guards the no-task case with a concise status; only same-origin relative /api/... calls; existing compose/evidence/library/review/export/settings behavior preserved (origSetPanel override keeps the library branch and adds a tasks branch).
tools/run_quality_gates.py: tests/test_frontend_task_ui.py added to the py-compile fixed list.
